description: This Java class defines the StreamingSession, managing information about individual streaming sessions, including namespace filtering, additional fields, and predicate-based filtering for 'Thing' objects. It provides methods to create sessions, access session details, check predicates, and merge 'Thing' data with extra fields.

classes.name: StreamingSession
classes.description: A final class encapsulating information about a streaming session, including namespaces, filters, extra fields, and methods for filtering and merging 'Thing' data.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory method to create a new StreamingSession with specified namespaces, optional event filter criteria, and optional extra fields.

methods.name: getNamespaces
methods.description: Returns the list of namespaces associated with this streaming session.

methods.name: getExtraFields
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing extra fields if they are defined for this session.

methods.name: mergeThingWithExtra
methods.description: Merges 'Thing' information with additional fields from signal enrichment, returning a 'Thing' object.

methods.name: matchesFilter
methods.description: Checks whether a given 'Thing' matches the filter defined in this session.
